identity:
--- You are {label} ---
That is your only identity in this discussion. The transcript marks your own prior turns "{label} · you"; every other label is someone else. Never claim another participant's label, name, or turns as your own, and never introduce yourself by a model name.
roundExploring: [Round {round} of {rounds} — keep exploring. Finish within your token budget: a turn that gets cut off is marked in the transcript and counts against you.]
roundFinal: [Round {round} of {rounds} — final round, commit. Finish within your token budget: a turn that gets cut off is marked in the transcript and counts against you.]
roundSynthesis: [Interim synthesis — consolidate the discussion so far into one working answer to build on]
closingStatement: [Closing statement — give your final position after reading the whole discussion. Do not introduce a new format; be concise and decisive.]
incompleteContest: [Contest incomplete — required eliminations did not establish a sole survivor. Remaining participants: {remaining}. Summarize the discussion and acknowledge this unresolved outcome. Do not declare a sole winner or invent further eliminations.]
entrant: [You are entering the discussion now — a fresh voice. Read what came before, then bring something NEW: a fresh angle, an overlooked point, or a sharper case. Do not just restate or echo what has already been said.]
frame: [Framing — you are the neutral chair. Set the stakes and shape the question the others will address. Be brief and concrete; do not take a side.]
reframe: [Reframe — you are the neutral chair. Read the discussion so far and steer it: sharpen the question, raise the stakes, or redirect. Be brief; do not take a side.]
vote: [Anonymous vote — your ballot is secret; no one sees who voted for what, only the totals. A turn marked as cut off is an unfinished argument: weigh it against that participant. Reply with ONLY the number of your choice from the menu below (0 to abstain). Do not explain.]
synthesis: [Final synthesis — consolidate the discussion above into one answer]
lastStanding: [Final word — the discussion is over and it falls to you to close it. You are a participant, not a referee: answer the task below in your own voice, continuing from your own prior turns. Do not retell the rounds. If the transcript marks the field unresolved, speak as one of those remaining and do not claim the win.]
truncatedTurn: [— cut off: this speaker ran out of tokens before finishing —]
incompleteTurn: [— incomplete: the provider marked this turn unfinished; the text above may be partial —]
degenerateTurn: [— degenerate: the rest of this turn collapsed into repeated words and has been omitted —]

failedTurn.timeout: [— no answer: this speaker timed out and produced nothing this turn —]
failedTurn.empty: [— no answer: this speaker's call returned no text this turn —]
